strings.records.gmo-domain-stop.title: GMO: perpetrator-site domain suspension and compensation guidance updates
strings.records.gmo-domain-stop.body: Report 13 confirms suspension of the perpetrator site's domain around 04:00 on 10/28. Suspension does not mean recovery of information, deletion of copies, or completion of service restoration. The maximum special relief payment of 300 ten-thousand yen in report 12 is conditional, not the total loss or amount already paid. Report 12 has a discrepancy between 19:10 in the heading and 19:00 in the timeline.
strings.records.gmo-domain-stop.action: Avoid perpetrator sites and leaked material; consult official individual communications, alternative environments, and compensation terms. Do not respond to opportunistic requests for credentials or fees.
strings.records.atlink-beta.title: @link: beta testing at some medical institutions, not full resumption.
strings.records.atlink-beta.body: The 10/28 12:30 update describes the start of cloud beta testing at some medical institutions. Patient apps, web reservations, and external-system integrations remain suspended. Effects on medical institutions' reservation operations continue, and the number of records affected by leakage remains under investigation.
strings.records.atlink-beta.action: Contact your medical institution directly about reservations or changes. Distinguish planned resumptions/refunds from completed actions, and check password reset guidance when service resumes.
strings.records.railway-signups.title: Railway: new registrations remain suspended; next report scheduled after the cutoff
strings.records.railway-signups.body: The status update at 10/27 15:19 UTC still reports suspension of new registrations, with no resumption date determined. Distinguish continued operation of existing deployments from build, dashboard, and other disruptions. Approximately 100,000 workspaces and up to 1.85% describe the potential scope of affected environment variables, not a confirmed number of people whose data leaked.
strings.records.railway-signups.action: Revoke and reissue old secrets at their issuers and audit them. Do not treat the next scheduled event, 10/28 16:00 UTC, as recovery achieved by this cutoff.
strings.records.studio-reporting.title: Studio: joint-report submissions planned for early 11
strings.records.studio-reporting.body: The update on the 28th at 00:30 says acceptance of joint reports to the Personal Information Protection Commission has not begun. Individual notification is not included in joint reporting. Reading of encryption keys and external accessibility were confirmed, but the number of records actually obtained remains undetermined.
strings.records.studio-reporting.action: Investigate actual use of form data and separately decide individual notification. Revoke external API keys with their issuers. Key rotation does not eliminate the possibility of earlier acquisition.
strings.records.kev-brotli-commerce.title: KEV: Brotli and Adobe Commerce added; reflect confirmed exploitation in priorities
strings.records.kev-brotli-commerce.body: CISA's 2026.10.27 edition contains 1,760 entries. CVE-2026-111497 and CVE-2026-48356 were newly added, with a 11/10 deadline. This confirms exploitation of the vulnerabilities; it does not mean every .NET or Node.js environment or merchant was compromised. Victim counts and actual losses are not provided.
strings.records.kev-brotli-commerce.action: Check product-specific fixes such as Brotli 1.2.1 and Node.js 22.23.4 / 24.22.1 / 26.12.1. For Adobe, check the version-specific July cumulative update in APSB26-73. Do not treat KEV deadlines for US federal agencies as legal deadlines for all users.

records.action: Treat the fix as unavailable, protect chain codes as secrets, and investigate the entire hierarchy. Do not reuse Agent2.4.4 / SDK2.19.1 from the separate eMudhra incident as fixed versions for this vulnerability.
